dialogue.content: When is our filing due in the Hollyoak rate case?
Actually, skip the filing date. What I need is how much the outside economist we retained for the Hollyoak case is charging.

Dr. Ingrid Solheim's engagement fee for the Hollyoak rate case is **$28,500**, which covers the written analysis and one day of hearing. Additional hearing days are **$3,400 each**.

She confirmed these terms in an email dated July 19, 2001 (em-15220), and said she can have a first draft to you by August 17.
